Pilot Agreement: Marlow Veterinary Group
Between Hollis Voice, Inc. (the Provider) and Marlow Veterinary Group (the Customer). Effective date:
2026-08-01.
1. Pilot. The Provider will run a pilot of its AI phone agent at 20 Customer locations. The pilot is a trial of
the service. It is not a subscription.
2. Term and fees. The pilot runs for six (6) months, from 2026-08-01 to 2027-01-31. The Customer pays
$15,000 a month, $90,000 in total, invoiced monthly.
3. Services. The Provider answers calls on the Customer's pilot phone lines and books appointments.
4. Setup. The Provider connects the phone lines and the appointment calendar during the first week.
